result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments from the comments list. I did not run tests, lint, or the app, as you asked, so everything below is checked by reading only.

**What changed** (all under `apps/react-vite/src`):

- **Mock API** (`testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts`): a new `PATCH /comments/:commentId` handler that takes `{ body }` and returns the comment in the same shape as the list endpoint, with the author attached. It returns 401 when signed out, 400 for an empty body, 404 for an unknown comment, and 403 when the caller is not the author. Only the author may edit, including admins, since the request was for the author.
- **API layer** (`features/comments/api/update-comment.ts`, new): `updateCommentInputSchema` (body required), the `updateComment` request, and a `useUpdateComment` mutation hook that refreshes the comments list on success.
- **Edit drawer** (`features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx`, new): an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer pre-filled with the current body. On success it shows a "Comment Updated" notification and closes the drawer.
- **Permission** (`lib/authorization.tsx`): a `comment:edit` policy, true only when the comment's author is the current user.
- **Comments list** (`features/comments/components/comments-list.tsx`): the Edit button sits next to Delete and is shown only through that policy.
- **Test** (`app/routes/app/discussions/__tests__/discussion.test.tsx`): an integration test that creates a comment, edits it, checks the success message, and checks the new text is shown. Project rules ask for a test with new behaviour; I wrote it without running it.

**Choices I made:**

- Admins cannot edit other members' comments, only delete them. The request said "the author", and the role table has no edit row.
- I did not add the "edited" mark. It is the first roadmap item and would need a model field, so it is left for that work.

**Pre-existing issue, not changed:** the comment header (date and author) is inside the delete-permission wrapper, so members who cannot delete a comment do not see its date or author at all. I left this alone because fixing it changes what every member sees.

I did not commit anything.
